messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — Legal finalized the offboarding data-retention policy this morning. Need to sync on manager comms + the mandatory compliance micro‑training for folks leaving the company.

julie: Copy. Do we have a short blurb for the handbook update or should I draft one?

miguel: I can paste a plain‑English version. Key points: 1) personal data removed within 30 days after exit unless retention is required for legal holds; 2) backups and logs may be retained up to 12 months for security investigations; 3) device images are purged unless user consent + manager signoff.

anya: That sounds good. We should also add an explicit checkbox on the offboarding form for employees to consent to short‑term retention for investigatory purposes. Sample language?

miguel: Suggested checkbox label: "I consent to short‑term retention of account logs and backups for incident investigation (up to 12 months)."

olivia: For hiring/offboarding ops, I need a list of which data fields to export before deprovisioning. Example CSV fields: name,email,employee_id,primary_repo_access,last_login,personal_device_serial. I can wire up the export.

sam: Managers — heads up: we also need to run a 15‑min exit interview micro‑training (how to collect personal items & walk through data retention options). Can we schedule a one‑week window for any exits?

anya: Plan: publish handbook update tomorrow, send manager brief + slide deck, and run a 15‑min training session (recorded) that managers must watch within 7 days of an exit. Olivia can run exports the day before deprovisioning.

julie: Draft for handbook entry (one paragraph): "When an employee departs, Redwood will remove personal account data within 30 days except where legal hold or security investigations require retention. Backups and logs may be retained up to 12 months. Employees will be offered an opt‑in consent to allow short‑term retention for investigatory follow‑up. Managers will be provided a short checklist and mandatory micro‑training." Thoughts?

miguel: LGTM. Add a link to the retention policy doc and the e‑sign consent form.

olivia: Link to the offboarding checklist + opt‑in form (internal): https://redwood.internal/oﬀboard/checklist — form id: OFF-2026-07 

anya: I'll add the e‑sign and a short FAQ (FAQ should answer: What is retained? Who can request deletion? How to request a legal hold?).

hr-bot: Reminder set — publish handbook update draft to #people-ops-docs and schedule manager training session for 2026-04-01 @10:00am PT.

sam: One more ask — can we get an export command we can run quickly? Olivia, maybe:

olivia: Sure, quick example for infra to run:
```
# export offboarding snapshot for user 1023
redwood-admin export --user 1023 --fields name,email,employee_id,primary_repo_access,last_login,device_serial --output /tmp/offboard-1023.csv
```

julie: Perfect. I'll iterate the handbook blurb and post in #people-ops-docs for review. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

anya: Thanks — will follow up after publishing with the tracking sheet (CSV of acknowledgements + manager training completions).
